scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.eval:ablate: GOTC_ABLATE=1 GOTC_SWEEP=1 vitest run tests/rank/ablate.test.ts tests/rank/sweep.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.gen:types: json2ts -i ../schema/cityfeed.schema.json -o src/lib/feed.generated.ts --bannerComment "/* GENERATED by \`make schema\` from gotc/schema.py — do not edit. */" --unreachableDefinitions && json2ts -i ../schema/citydetails.schema.json -o src/lib/details.generated.ts --bannerComment "/* GENERATED by \`make schema\` from gotc/schema.py — do not edit. */" && json2ts -i ../schema/citymanifest.schema.json -o src/lib/manifest.generated.ts --bannerComment "/* GENERATED by \`make schema\` from gotc/schema.py — do not edit. */"
